title: Protected browser session settings v1
description: Content of browser.json in the Helm-rendered settings ConfigMap. No credentials or public configuration API. The hub watches the ConfigMap; a change applies to new sessions and shortens existing ones to the new maxLifetimeSeconds. A session ends at the earlier of creation plus maxLifetimeSeconds and the last authenticated request plus inactivityTimeoutSeconds. There is no login or session cap (ADR-335 D8); expired rows are deleted and login is bounded by the ingress rate limit. Current user permissions remain independently required.

maxLifetimeSeconds.description: Maximum session lifetime from creation; default 7 days. Not capped: the provider's refresh-token lifetime ends a session independently.

inactivityTimeoutSeconds.description: Session ends this long after the last authenticated request; default 24 hours. Use slides it, never the maximum.
